idea: Fixed-fee AI readiness diagnostic for professional firms
pain: They do not know where to start and will not commit to a big programme
v1: A two-week diagnostic with a scored report
verdict: A well-shaped productised entry point that reliably leads to larger work.

why.distribution: 50+ reachable firms across finance and architecture; a fixed-fee diagnostic is an easy first yes.
why.demand: Firms are buying diagnostics now, though this specific offer is untested.
why.fmf: Her actual former remit, productised into a fixed scope.
why.revenue_structure: One-off, but designed to lead to a retainer.
why.defensibility: The scoring framework accumulates comparative data across firms.
why.leverage: A fixed framework applied repeatedly - genuinely productised rather than bespoke.
why.ceiling: £8.5k x 24 diagnostics = £204k, at two weeks each which exceeds a part-time year.

ceiling_arithmetic: £8.5k x 24 diagnostics = £204k. Twenty-four two-week diagnostics is more than a full year, so the honest cap is 12-15 = £102-128k unless it converts into retainers, which is the actual design intent.
carries: The easiest first sale in the AI cluster, fixed scope, fast delivery, and a natural bridge to i017's retainers.
kills: One-off by nature. Its value is as a funnel rather than as the business itself.
test: Offer the diagnostic at £7.5k to four firms across both networks.
test_pass: Two book, and at least one asks what comes next.
test_fail: They want the findings without paying for the diagnosis.
